domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains to check, one per line (URLs are fine; www. is stripped). Up to 20,000.

keywords.title: Keywords (name ideas)
keywords.description: Optional: brand or name ideas. Each is combined with every TLD below, e.g. 'acme' + com, io, ai.

tlds.title: TLDs for keywords
tlds.description: TLDs to combine with keywords (without the dot). Default: com.
